entries.name: ReturnViewHandle
entries.description: Returns a cube view as the drillthrough result. Belongs in the Epilog of a }Drill_* process, inside the generated-statements block.

entries.name: ReturnSQLTableHandle
entries.description: Returns the ODBC result set of the process datasource as the drillthrough result. Takes no arguments and is written bare: ReturnSQLTableHandle; Belongs in the Epilog of a }Drill_* process.
